title: Volvo Trucks North America: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (1,275 affected)
summary: THE MAIN ELECTRICAL POWER HARNESS WAS MISROUTED. IF THERE WAS AN ELECTRICAL SHORT IN THIS HARNESS, THE CIRCUIT WOULD NOT BE FUSE-PROTECTED.

title: Ford Motor Company: EQUIPMENT:CARRIER:SPARE TIRE (9,400 affected)
summary: THE SPARE TIRE SUPPLIED WITH THE VEHICLE CAN CONTACT THE BRAKE LINES ON THE REAR AXLE IF IT IS MOUNTED IN THE UNDERBODY SPARE TIRE CARRIER.  SUCH CONTACT COULD RESULT IN FRACTURE OF A REAR BRAKE LINE.

title: BUELL-out of business: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:FITTINGS (443 affected)
summary: FRONT BRAKE LINE ASSEMBLY CAN CRACK AT EITHER OF THE FITTINGS, ALLOWING BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE.

title: WAYNE WHEELED VEHICLES: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (317 affected)
summary: DURING INSTALLATION OF THE REAR SEATS, THE DRILLS USED TO CREATE PILOT HOLES FOR MOUNTING THE REAR SEAT PENETRATED THE FUEL TANK CROSSOVER PIPE LOCATED BEHIND THE REAR SPRING HANGER BRACKET ABOVE THE REAR SPRING. THE DAMAGED FUEL LINES CAN CAUSE FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: EKLEY INDUSTRIES: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER (130 affected)
summary: INCONSISTENT WELDING TECHNIQUE CAN CAUSE AXLE SPINDLE WELD TO CRACK, CAUSING MISALIGNMENT OF THE SPINDLE ASSEMBLY OR POSSIBLE SEPARATION OF THE SPINDLE AND WHEEL.

title: KEYSTONE, INC.: AIR CONDITIONER:OTHER PART (10,000 affected)
summary: THE SCRIM USED IN PRODUCTION TO SHAPE FILTERS IS FLAMMABLE AND SHOULD HAVE BEEN REMOVED PRIOR TO SHIPMENT. THIS FILTER SCRIM CAN IGNITE. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 302, "FLAMMABILITY OF INTERIOR MATERIALS."

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINKAGE:PEDAL (262 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE PEDAL PIVOT BOLT WAS STARTED IN THE WELD NUT, BUT WAS NOT TORQUED CORRECTLY CAUSING THE BOLT TO DISENGAGE FROM THE WELD NUT.

title: Ford Motor Company: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (560 affected)
summary: THE DRAG LINK INSTALLED CAN CONTACT THE FRONT AXLE I-BEAM UNDER CERTAIN EXTREME CONDITIONS. THIS DRAG LINK WAS NOT INTENDED TO BE INSTALLED ON "LOW PROFILE" VEHICLES.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/ENGINE:DIESEL (60,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIGHT DUTY PICKUP TRUCKS, VANS AND MOTORHOMES EQUIPPED WITH ELECTRONICALLY FUEL INJECTED 6.5L DIESEL ENGINE.   THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION PART 573. HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.  THE CAMPAIGN WILL IMPROVE THE OVERALL DRIVEABILITY OF THESE VEHICLES.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (200 affected)
summary: TRUCKS WERE ASSEMBLED WITHOUT A DOOR LOCK PLATE IN THE RIGHT SIDE DOOR.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: LIGHTING:LIGHT AND COMMUNICATIONS:REFLECTIVE DEVIC (33 affected)
summary: THE REAR LIGHTS DID NOT HAVE REFLECTIVE DEVICES INSTALLED. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (192 affected)
summary: THE ECM GROUND TERMINALS WERE INSTALLED SUCH THAT THERE IS RESIDUAL STRESS ON THE TERMINAL CAUSING THE TERMINAL TO FATIGUE AND EVENTUALLY FAIL.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SHOULDER BELTS (91,275 affected)
summary: INSUFFICIENT LUBRICATION IN THE GUIDE TRACK RAIL IN WHICH THE SHOULDER BELT CARRIER MOVES CAUSING A CHATTERING NOISE, MOMENTARY BINDING WHILE TRAVELING, CYCLING BACK AND FORTH, OR STOPS COMPLETELY.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND FUSE RECEPTICLE (138 affected)
summary: THE 12 VOLT BUSS BAR AND TERMINAL CONNECTOR LUG POST WERE INSTALLED WITHOUT A PROTECTIVE COVER.  THESE COMPONENTS ARE SUSCEPTIBLE TO POTENTIAL SHORTING UPON CONTACT BY ANY TYPE OF METAL FOREIGN OBJECT.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT:RADIO:TAPE DECK ETC. (313 affected)
summary: THE REMOTE POWER SWITCH(ES) LOCATED ON THE HYDRAULIC MOTOR THAT OPERATES THE SLIDE-OUT ROOM IS NOT WATER-PROOF ALLOWING MOISTURE TO PENETRATE INTO THE SWITCH CREATING AN ELECTRICAL PATH.

title: PHILATRON INTERNATIONAL: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (1,505 affected)
summary: DURING FINAL ASSEMBLY CRIMPING PROCESS THE INTERNAL SUPPORT TUBE WAS DAMAGED AND DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 106, "BRAKE HOSES."

title: Jaguar Cars, Ltd.: STEERING:LINKAGES (48 affected)
summary: THE STEERING ASSEMBLY WAS FITTED WITH INCORRECT SPECIFICATION NUTS.  THESE NUTS RETAIN THE TRACK ROD END BALL PINS TO THE STEERING ARMS.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER (500 affected)
summary: THE RIGHT FRONT BRAKE CALIPER PISTON SEAL GROOVE WAS IMPROPERLY MACHINED CAUSING A BRAKE FLUID LEAK WHEN THE BRAKES ARE APPLIED.
